svg.aria-label: Keyboard Maestro (the editor): Where you write and change macros; Saves itself seconds after each change; no Save; Quit it when you're done. Keyboard Maestro Engine (the Engine): Runs in the background, no window; Hears hot keys, watches the time, tracks apps; The part that actually runs your macros. Keep the Engine running: turn on Launch Engine at Login in Keyboard Maestro's preferences, and it starts when you log in.
